hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/public/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/popup.html|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/offscreen.html|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/build-content.mjs|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/vite.config.ts) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run build >/tmp/notion-exporter-build.log 2>&1 && echo '{"systemMessage":"Extension rebuilt (dist/)"}' || echo '{"systemMessage":"Extension build FAILED - see /tmp/notion-exporter-build.log"}';; esac
